stories.title: About 15 missing after flash flood tears through Grand Canyon
stories.description: Search and rescue operations continued Sunday after Saturday's flood destroyed bridges and forced the helicopter evacuation of 62 people.

stories.title: GOP anxiety grows as Talarico outspends Paxton 7-to-1 in Texas Senate race
stories.description: Democrats have dominated Texas airwaves since June while MAGA Inc. sits on its $400 million war chest, leaving Paxton financially stranded.

stories.title: Trump says Venezuelan oil will refill US strategic reserve
stories.description: The reserve holds about 290 million barrels, near a multi-decade low, after drawdowns under both the Biden and Trump administrations.

stories.title: Ferry capsizes off Northern Cyprus, killing 7 with 23 missing
stories.description: A catamaran carrying 267 people sank after departing Kyrenia for Turkey, with 237 rescued as a major search operation continues.

stories.title: Pentagon to take 35% stake in Venezuela oil venture
stories.description: The Defense Department plans to invest in a private company granted 100-year rights to develop 17 Venezuelan oil fields holding 65 billion barrels.

stories.title: Trump says NBC's Welker will be reported to FCC
stories.description: The president accused the "Meet the Press" host of misrepresenting his endorsement record, seeking her "rebuke or punishment."

stories.title: China says 261 foreigners from 23 nations missing after Himalayan mudslide
stories.description: Officials released the first nationality breakdown of those unaccounted for on the Tibetan side, as the combined death toll surpassed 690.

stories.title: Iceland votes against resuming EU membership talks
stories.description: Voters rejected the proposal 52.5% to 47.5%, settling the question for a second time after accession talks were abandoned in 2015.

stories.title: NBC News crew and Palestinian woman beaten by masked Israeli settlers in West Bank
stories.description: Netanyahu condemned the attack in Jalud as Israeli security forces said they confiscated settler vehicles and opened a police investigation.

stories.title: Man charged with arson after setting himself on fire in NYC Google building
stories.description: John Butch, 63, allegedly used lighter fluid to self-immolate Friday in the lobby of a Lower Manhattan building housing Google and NYPD offices.

stories.title: DHS deports pro-deportation commentator Yiannopoulos to UK
stories.description: The far-right British provocateur, who called for ICE checkpoints and mass deportations, was himself removed after overstaying his visa since 2019.

stories.title: Crockett declines to campaign with Talarico in Texas Senate race
stories.description: The congresswoman told CNN she will focus on down-ballot candidates, declining to join the Democratic nominee who defeated her in the March primary.

stories.title: IRGC declares 'decisive control' over Strait of Hormuz, calls US claims 'lies'
stories.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said the strait remains closed to all ships without Iranian coordination, hours after the U.S. said it had cleared all mines.

stories.title: NPS endorses Trump's arch despite harm to 36 DC landmarks
stories.description: A 133-page report found the proposed 250-foot gilded arch would disrupt sightlines across Washington but called its Memorial Circle site irreplaceable.

stories.title: Hegseth weighs summoning military leaders to Quantico again
stories.description: The defense secretary could use a second large-scale gathering to announce new directives, according to the Wall Street Journal.

stories.title: US sanctions Egyptian bank's UAE branches over Iran ties
stories.description: Treasury moved to cut Banque Misr's six UAE branches from the U.S. financial system, calling them a "critical node" for Iranian dollar access.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump deportation of pro-Palestinian students
stories.description: A federal judge ruled that two immigration law provisions used to target noncitizen students over pro-Palestinian speech violate the First and Fifth Amendments.

stories.title: Fed Chair Warsh signals rate hikes may be needed as inflation stays elevated
stories.description: In his Jackson Hole debut, Warsh said underlying inflation trends have not "meaningfully improved" and current rates may not be restricting growth.

stories.title: Chevron, Halliburton near deals to invest billions in Venezuela's oil fields
stories.description: The Wall Street Journal reports U.S. energy firms are positioning for a historic return to Venezuela following Maduro's removal in January.

stories.title: CFTC orders Trump teleprompter operator to pay $172K
stories.description: Gabriel Perez used advance access to presidential speeches to place insider trades on prediction market Kalshi, the agency said.

stories.title: Pakistan says it won't comply with US sanctions on Iran
stories.description: Islamabad joins Beijing in rejecting Washington's "Operation Economic Outcast," vowing to continue and expand trade with Tehran.

stories.title: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89 after weeks in hospital
stories.description: Europe's oldest reigning monarch died peacefully Friday morning at Oslo University Hospital after battling a bacterial blood infection.

stories.title: Trump administration quietly pushing to give Yosemite land to private developer
stories.description: A NOTUS investigation found the National Park Service has spent over a year working to cede a strip of parkland to a Nevada real estate firm.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia nears renewed war with Houthis as oil routes come under siege
stories.description: Diplomatic channels have collapsed after weeks of Houthi attacks on Saudi ships and oil facilities, with analysts warning that full-scale conflict appears imminent.

stories.title: Venezuela weighs leaving OPEC as US oil ties deepen
stories.description: A founding member of the 65-year-old cartel is in talks with Washington about a departure that would mark the second exit in months.

stories.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow discharge of transgender troops
stories.description: The DOJ filed a petition Friday seeking to overturn lower court rulings that block the Pentagon from removing about 4,200 transgender service members.

stories.title: FDA approves updated COVID vaccines targeting XFG variant
stories.description: Shots from Moderna, Pfizer-BioNTech, and Novavax-Sanofi are approved for older adults and high-risk individuals ahead of fall.

stories.title: New York AG sues last sheriff defying state's ICE ban
stories.description: Attorney General Letitia James filed suit Thursday against Rensselaer County's sheriff for refusing to end his office's cooperation agreement with ICE.

stories.title: Federal judge blocks Trump's bid to erase hush money conviction for third time
stories.description: Judge Hellerstein ruled Trump's presidential immunity arguments were "neither new nor legally sufficient" to move the case to federal court.

stories.title: FAA moves to fire two controllers who left early before fatal LaGuardia crash
stories.description: Two air traffic controllers departed about an hour before their shifts ended on the night of the deadly March 22 collision.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic lead 100+ firms in AI cyber threat warning
stories.description: The open letter urges governments and businesses to treat cyber defense as an immediate priority before AI-powered attacks overwhelm critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Trump admin drafts rule to block China's remote AI chip access
stories.description: The Commerce Department could share the proposed export control with industry groups as early as September, though legal hurdles loom.

stories.title: Documents contradict RFK Jr.'s claim Samoa trip was unrelated to vaccines
stories.description: Letters show Kennedy wrote Samoa's prime minister proposing to study MMR vaccines before his 2019 visit, despite telling senators the trip had "nothing to do with vaccines."

stories.title: Iran war's drain on US weapons stockpiles alarms Asian allies
stories.description: Six months into the conflict, dwindling Patriot and Tomahawk missile supplies are raising fears about U.S. readiness for a potential confrontation with China.

stories.title: Judge declines to block Trump's new birthright order
stories.description: The ruling allows the administration to implement a revised executive order issued after the Supreme Court struck down its earlier attempt.

stories.title: Hamas agrees to surrender weapons in historic first, Board of Peace says
stories.description: The group accepted a 15-point roadmap for full disarmament and governance transfer, but Israel's rejection has stalled implementation.

stories.title: Four EU states urge Brussels to unlock frozen Russian assets for Ukraine
stories.description: Sweden, the Netherlands, Spain, and Poland sent a letter calling on the European Commission to restart work on using over €200 billion in frozen Russian funds.

stories.title: Judge blocks Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic
stories.description: The ruling found the Trump administration's supply-chain risk designation violated the AI company's First and Fifth Amendment rights.

stories.title: Second tanker hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz this week
stories.description: Qatar's PM heads to Tehran for de-escalation talks as attacks on shipping intensify in the contested waterway six months into the U.S.-Iran war.

stories.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
stories.description: The deal for the open-source AI model platform would be one of the chipmaker's largest acquisitions amid an aggressive dealmaking spree.

stories.title: Most people arrested by ICE in July had no criminal record, data shows
stories.description: Federal data reveals ICE averaged over 1,580 arrests daily in July, with more than half involving people with no criminal history.

stories.title: Secret Service places 3 officials on leave amid misconduct probe
stories.description: The agency's communications chief and two colleagues lost their security clearances as the Office of Professional Responsibility investigates undisclosed allegations.

stories.title: Haiti gang threatens to kill 50 hostages after Kenscoff massacre
stories.description: A gang leader posted a video Wednesday showing captives and warning they would be executed if security forces continue operations.

stories.title: Trump DOJ raises doubts about prosecuting Fauci for contempt of Congress
stories.description: Administration officials question whether the legal strategy behind the Senate's contempt referral is strong enough to support an indictment.

stories.title: Nvidia shares rally after Q2 revenue doubles, topping estimates
stories.description: CEO Jensen Huang said AI has reached an "inflection point" as the chipmaker posted $96.2 billion in quarterly revenue and guided above consensus.

stories.title: Appeals court rules Rep. McIver must face assault trial
stories.description: A divided Third Circuit panel found the Speech or Debate Clause does not shield McIver from charges tied to a confrontation at a Newark detention facility.

stories.title: Trump admin proposes treating billion-dollar firms as small businesses
stories.description: The rule would raise size thresholds dramatically, allowing companies with up to $1 billion in revenue to access federal contracts and loans reserved for small firms.

stories.title: FDA approves first drug targeting genetic driver of pancreatic cancer
stories.description: Rasonque, made by Revolution Medicines, nearly doubled survival time in trials and was approved 6.5 months ahead of schedule.

stories.title: DHS admits its noncitizen voter roll figures were inflated
stories.description: After claiming nearly 16,000 noncitizens were on Nevada's rolls, DHS provided a list of just 185 and declined to share supporting data.

stories.title: Cook's lawyer says no grounds for Trump to fire Fed governor
stories.description: Attorney Abbe David Lowell called mortgage fraud allegations "unfounded and untrue" in a letter sent to the White House on Wednesday.

stories.title: Bill Gates warns 'there is no plan' for AI upheaval in new essay
stories.description: The Microsoft co-founder calls for global regulation, new institutions and an AI tax, warning of mass job loss and rising security threats.

stories.title: Same-name challenger advances to Alaska Senate general election
stories.description: Dan J. Sullivan, a retired teacher, secured a spot alongside incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola in November's ranked-choice contest.

stories.title: Trump vows to 'teach Canada' as trade war escalates with matching tariffs
stories.description: Canada announced dollar-for-dollar counter-tariffs on more than $27 billion in U.S. goods after Trump imposed 50% duties on Canadian products.

stories.title: DeSantis calls Flock cameras 'out of control' amid bipartisan revolt
stories.description: Over 100 cities have dropped Flock Safety's license plate readers as lawmakers push federal legislation to curb AI-powered surveillance.

stories.title: USS Lincoln to dock in Thailand after 200-plus days at sea
stories.description: The carrier's roughly 5,000 sailors and Marines will get their first port call since mid-December after a record-breaking deployment in the Middle East.

stories.title: Trump says Iran's Khamenei alive but 'very seriously wounded'
stories.description: The president offered his most detailed assessment of the Iranian Supreme Leader, who has not been seen publicly since the February strikes that killed his father.

stories.title: Dolly Parton, queen of country music, dies at 80
stories.description: The singer-songwriter, actress and entrepreneur who rose from rural Tennessee poverty to global stardom died Tuesday, her family said.

stories.title: Anthropic to pitch $30T market opportunity ahead of IPO
stories.description: The Claude maker is preparing to tell investors its addressable market exceeds $30 trillion as it targets an October listing valued at $2 trillion.

stories.title: Trump administration pauses visa appointments worldwide
stories.description: The State Department cited a "global training initiative" for consular officers, days after a judge struck down a 75-country visa ban.

stories.title: China vows to fight back after US sanctions Chinese entities over Iran ties
stories.description: Beijing warned it will take "all necessary measures" to protect its interests after Washington sanctioned over 60 entities in its "Operation Economic Outcast" campaign.

stories.title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
stories.description: The Lancaster County deaths are the first measles fatalities in Pennsylvania in 35 years and the first in the U.S. this year.

stories.title: Darline Graham wins SC GOP Senate runoff, validating Trump endorsement
stories.description: Graham defeated Rep. Ralph Norman on Tuesday despite debate gaffe concerns, and will face a Democrat in November as the heavy favorite.

stories.title: US declines to join 50-nation UN rebuke of Russia over Ukraine strikes
stories.description: Washington again broke with allies, calling on "both sides" to negotiate instead of condemning Russian aggression at a Security Council session.

stories.title: Ukraine stages world's first drone-only military parade
stories.description: Unmanned ground vehicles, naval drones, and aerial systems replaced soldiers on Kyiv's streets to mark 35 years of independence.

stories.title: Trump sends Saudi nuclear deal to Congress, ties it to Israel recognition
stories.description: The 30-year pact, reached in July, would allow U.S. exports of civilian nuclear technology to the kingdom, including AP1000 reactors.

stories.title: Grocers sue NYC over city-run supermarket plan
stories.description: The Multicultural Business Coalition filed two lawsuits Monday to block Mayor Mamdani's $70 million plan for five government-owned grocery stores.

stories.title: AI-guided Russian drone killed 3 Ukrainians autonomously, officials say
stories.description: Ukrainian officials say a drone with no human pilot made the targeting decision, marking the war's first confirmed fully autonomous AI weapon strike.

stories.title: US intel warned Trump killing Khamenei would backfire, WSJ reports
stories.description: Six months into the Iran conflict, a Wall Street Journal investigation reveals intelligence officials cautioned Trump the operation could empower a more extreme regime.

stories.title: EU approves $7.1 billion in defense aid for Ukraine
stories.description: The funding, announced on Ukraine's Independence Day, targets air defense systems, missiles, ammunition, and radars as Russian aerial attacks intensify.

stories.title: Iran threatens fines, detention for ships violating Hormuz transit rules
stories.description: The warning from Tehran's new maritime authority escalates tensions as the U.S. prepares to roll out sweeping new sanctions against Iran on Monday.

stories.title: Lutnick pushed last-minute demands before US-Canada trade talk collapse
stories.description: Trump threatened to raise tariffs on Canadian vehicles, auto parts, and steel to 50% by January as the two nations trade blame over the breakdown.

stories.title: Florida start-up making low-cost drone interceptors for the Iran war
stories.description: Powerus is producing its Guardian interceptor locally in the Emirates to fill gaps in allied air defenses as the U.S.-Iran war drains American-made stockpiles.

stories.title: Over 200 Chinese vessels mass near Philippine reef as Beijing announces live-fire drills
stories.description: Satellite imagery shows fishing boats in militia-like formations at Mischief Reef, raising fears of a move on Second Thomas Shoal.

stories.title: Nevada sues to block Trump administration's Colorado River cuts
stories.description: The lawsuit, the first legal challenge to the plan finalized Friday, alleges cuts of up to 71% to Nevada's allocation could devastate Las Vegas.

stories.title: Zelenskyy denies Ukraine role in Nord Stream blasts
stories.description: The Ukrainian president spoke after a second Ukrainian suspect was arrested in Croatia over the 2022 pipeline sabotage.

stories.title: Syria set to leave U.S. terrorism sponsor list after 47 years
stories.description: Congress's 45-day review period expired Saturday without opposition, clearing the way for formal removal pending Federal Register publication.

stories.title: Trump plans to revoke 200,000 visas from asylum seekers
stories.description: The move would be the largest single visa revocation in U.S. history, targeting those who entered on tourist or business visas.

stories.title: Iran urges Qatar to move detained pilots to hospital on land
stories.description: Tehran claims the airmen are being held on water in poor condition, but Qatar denies holding any surviving pilots.

stories.title: FDA urges recall of alfalfa sprouts tied to E. coli outbreak in 15 states
stories.description: At least 55 people have been sickened and four hospitalized in a dual E. coli and salmonella outbreak linked to a Minnesota sprout grower.

stories.title: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Canadian autos to 50% in January
stories.description: The announcement escalates a trade war with Ottawa days after bilateral negotiations collapsed, with Canada vowing to retaliate "dollar for dollar."

stories.title: Supreme Court lets White House ballroom construction continue
stories.description: Chief Justice Roberts froze a lower court order that would have halted the $400 million project at midnight, buying time for the justices to review the case.

stories.title: Cuba says US sanctions undercut the economic reforms Washington long demanded
stories.description: Havana's UN ambassador questioned why Washington keeps escalating penalties even as Cuba opens its economy to private investment and foreign business.

stories.title: Trump disclosure reveals 1,000 stock trades in June
stories.description: A filing released Friday shows the president sold Meta shares and bought Berkshire Hathaway amid a broad portfolio reshuffling.

stories.title: NATO's eastern allies offer to cover US base costs amid troop review
stories.description: Frontline states are preparing a cost-sharing bid ahead of a meeting with a Pentagon official next week, hoping to keep American forces in the region.

stories.title: Texas court cuts Alex Jones' Sandy Hook verdict from $50M to $1.5M
stories.description: The appeals court found the trial judge improperly let damages exceed the state's $750,000 statutory cap on exemplary damages.

stories.title: Trump warns Democrats will impeach him if GOP loses midterms
stories.description: At a South Carolina rally Friday, the president urged Republicans to treat November's elections as a referendum on his presidency.

stories.title: Vance says US moving up to 15M barrels daily through Hormuz despite Iran blockade
stories.description: The vice president said a military-protected shipping corridor is preventing the energy crisis Iran is trying to create.

stories.title: Ukraine asks Musk to allow Starlink strikes deep into Russia
stories.description: Kyiv wants to use Starlink-equipped drones to hit Russian missile launchers up to 200 km inside Russia amid a critical Patriot shortage.

stories.title: Trump moves to block BBC subpoenas of family in $10B suit
stories.description: Lawyers argue the BBC's bid to compel testimony from Ivanka Trump, Donald Trump Jr. and Jared Kushner is a "politically charged" fishing expedition.

stories.title: Hong Kong convicts Tiananmen vigil leaders of subversion
stories.description: Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung were found guilty of inciting subversion for advocating an end to one-party rule in China. They face up to 10 years in prison.

stories.title: Somali pirates seize 2 ships in 4 days as hijackings hit decade high
stories.description: Six ships and over 100 crew members are now held captive as naval forces stretched by Middle East conflicts leave Somali waters less patrolled.

stories.title: Trump administration dismisses a dozen Fannie Mae executives
stories.description: Several top officials, including the chief economist and multifamily COO, were fired Wednesday as AI was cited as a factor in the cuts.

stories.title: New York Times ordered to pay $9.25M in landmark defamation verdict
stories.description: An Alabama jury found the Times defamed former walk-on player Kai Spears, marking the paper's first U.S. defamation trial loss in over 50 years.

stories.title: Wahab wins California special election despite AIPAC spending
stories.description: State Sen. Aisha Wahab defeated Melissa Hernandez to fill Rep. Eric Swalwell's vacated House seat, overcoming millions in outside spending.

stories.title: Trump administration plans $725M payment toward UN debt
stories.description: The transfer covers less than 20% of the more than $4 billion the UN says Washington owes, according to Reuters.

stories.title: Seven nations urge Israel to withdraw E1 settlement tenders
stories.description: The UK summoned Israel's chargé d'affaires and joined six other Western governments in calling the West Bank construction plan "unacceptable."

stories.title: China builds 'unprecedented' maritime presence east of Taiwan
stories.description: A new AMTI report says Beijing deployed law enforcement ships and hailed nearly 200 commercial vessels in the Philippine Sea since June.

stories.title: Pentagon fires Stars and Stripes editor and publisher
stories.description: The dismissals follow months of clashes over the Trump administration's efforts to exert control over the military's independent newspaper.

stories.title: FBI raids Swalwell's home, seizes devices in misconduct probe
stories.description: Agents executed search warrants at San Francisco's airport and his D.C. residence over the weekend as part of a federal sexual assault investigation.

stories.title: Bessent says Treasury buybacks could top $4B per operation
stories.description: The Treasury secretary signaled further expansion of bond repurchases a day after doubling the program, citing "very poor" liquidity in long-term debt.

stories.title: US, Japan, South Korea hold urgent talks after North Korean missile barrage
stories.description: Senior diplomats coordinated their response Friday after Pyongyang fired about 10 ballistic missiles, dismissing Trump's scaled-back military drills.

stories.title: FBI arrests woman in ISIS-inspired plot to bomb N.Y. Capitol
stories.description: Jessica Bowie, 35, of Albany was charged with planning to deploy an explosive at the state Capitol to kill lawmakers, the DOJ said.

stories.title: Romania destroys explosive sea drone near major Black Sea gas platform
stories.description: EU chief von der Leyen called the incident "hybrid warfare" as Romania's president blamed Russia for escalating threats to critical energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Trump threatens $5B lawsuit against think tank over National Guard report
stories.description: CAP CEO Neera Tanden called the threatened defamation suit "baseless" and said the organization would "neither cower nor bend."

stories.title: Evergrande founder sentenced to life in prison by Chinese court
stories.description: Hui Ka Yan was convicted on eight charges including fraud and embezzlement after the property giant's $300 billion default shook China's economy.

stories.title: Army phases out drone battalion in Hegseth-backed shift
stories.description: The cutting-edge unit, established in Europe in January to master drone warfare lessons from Ukraine, will revert to conventional airborne infantry.

stories.title: White House furor over Natalie Harp intensifies after week of damaging leaks
stories.description: A pointed remark by Sen. Jon Ossoff about Trump's ever-present aide spiraled into a national story after the West Wing's aggressive pushback backfired.

stories.title: US envoy warns Israel-Turkey nearly reached direct military confrontation over Syria strike
stories.description: Tom Barrack said Turkish forces were unaware of incoming Israeli jets and could have scrambled fighters, risking a dangerous escalation.

stories.title: Harry and Meghan moving back to Britain after 6 years
stories.description: The couple's children are enrolled in a British school starting in September, with the family relocating to a private home outside London.

stories.title: Trump admin moves to strip ABA of law school accreditation power
stories.description: The Education Department is beginning formal proceedings to revoke the ABA's authority as the sole accreditor of the nation's law schools.

stories.title: Ousted defense chief Fedorov calls for wartime elections in biggest challenge to Zelenskyy
stories.description: Once a close Zelenskyy ally, Mykhailo Fedorov cited a "systemic crisis of governance" and condemned corruption in a nine-minute YouTube address.

stories.title: Germany condemns Ben-Gvir, drops opposition to EU sanctions
stories.description: Berlin had previously blocked EU sanctions against the Israeli minister but now backs action after his call for nightly killings in Gaza.

stories.title: Trump withholds mandated 2024 election interference report
stories.description: The administration has released hundreds of pages of other declassified material while keeping the congressionally required foreign interference assessment secret.

stories.title: Merck, Moderna mRNA cancer vaccine succeeds in Phase 3 trial
stories.description: Intismeran, a personalized mRNA therapy, reduced melanoma recurrence when added to Keytruda, marking the first positive Phase 3 result for a neoantigen cancer treatment.

stories.title: Unitree Robotics surges 460% in Shanghai debut
stories.description: China's first publicly traded humanoid robot maker closed its first day of trading at 845 yuan, up from an IPO price of 150.8 yuan.

stories.title: Trump joins Michael Cohen's radio show in public reunion
stories.description: Cohen, the star witness in Trump's 2024 hush money trial, hosted the president on his WABC program after months of quiet reconciliation.

stories.title: Florida primaries oust Rep. Mills, advance Trump-backed newcomers
stories.description: Redrawn congressional maps reshaped Tuesday's races, with an ethics-plagued incumbent falling and first-time candidates winning key GOP nominations.

stories.title: Hegseth accused of hiding Iran's destruction of key US base in Bahrain
stories.description: The allegation helps explain why the USS Abraham Lincoln's 5,000 sailors have faced food shortages and deteriorating conditions during a record 250-day deployment.

stories.title: North Korea fires 10+ missiles hours after Trump vows to meet Kim Jong Un
stories.description: Pyongyang's largest single-day volley this year came as curtailed US-South Korea military exercises near their end.

stories.title: Ex-Fauci adviser pleads guilty to concealing COVID-19 records
stories.description: David Morens admitted to conspiring to evade public records laws tied to pandemic research grants, including efforts to revive a controversial bat coronavirus grant.

stories.title: Angie Nixon upsets Vindman in Florida Senate primary
stories.description: The Democratic socialist and Jacksonville state lawmaker defeated the heavily favored impeachment witness despite being outspent roughly 16 to 1.

stories.title: Navy weighs renaming carrier honoring Black WWII hero after Trump
stories.description: The Ford-class carrier CVN-81, designated USS Doris Miller during Trump's first term, may become the first carrier named for a sitting president.

stories.title: US sanctions ICC president in latest bid to dismantle court
stories.description: Secretary of State Rubio called the ICC "corrupt and fatally politicized" as Washington targeted the court's top judge and a senior trial lawyer.

stories.title: Wasserman Schultz wins Florida primary in historically Black district
stories.description: The former DNC chair defeated four Black candidates after a divided field failed to consolidate, drawing sharp criticism over race and representation.

stories.title: Minnesota sues Texas to force extradition of ICE agent charged in shooting
stories.description: AG Keith Ellison filed a federal lawsuit against Gov. Abbott, warning the agent could walk free from a border jail by Aug. 26.

stories.title: EU leaders back ICC after US sanctions its president
stories.description: Half of the ICC's judges are now under U.S. sanctions as the Trump administration escalates its campaign against the Hague-based court.

stories.title: Israel orders troops to halt Gaza advance after Kushner meeting
stories.description: The directive marks the first time Israeli forces were told to stop expanding westward since the ceasefire began last October.

stories.title: Mangione state murder trial postponed after federal plea
stories.description: His lawyers argue New York's double jeopardy law bars the state from prosecuting him for the same conduct he admitted to in federal court.

stories.title: Trump taps White House aide Overton to lead FDA
stories.description: The pick follows months of turmoil at the agency after its previous commissioner departed amid clashes with staff and industry.

stories.title: DOJ to deploy 1,000 election monitors for midterms
stories.description: Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon announced the dramatic expansion Monday, also signaling the voter roll legal battle could reach the Supreme Court.

stories.title: Tupac Shakur murder trial opens with testimony in Las Vegas
stories.description: Prosecutors say Duane "Keffe D" Davis planned the 1996 drive-by shooting in retaliation for a beating of his nephew earlier that evening.

stories.title: Judge lifts last block on Trump ending TPS protections
stories.description: Ethiopia was the final country shielded by a court order. The ruling follows the Supreme Court's June decision curbing judicial review of TPS terminations.

stories.title: AG Blanche finalizes rule letting non-violent felons seek gun rights restoration
stories.description: The DOJ expects about 330,000 applications in the first year. Violent felons and sex offenders remain presumptively ineligible.

stories.title: Big Tech carries $3T in hidden AI spending commitments, WSJ finds
stories.description: Nine major tech firms have nearly five times more AI-related financial obligations than their reported capital expenditures suggest, according to a new analysis.

stories.title: Trump scales back Korea military drills over stalled $350B investment pledge
stories.description: Commerce Secretary Lutnick met Monday with Seoul's trade minister as the U.S. pressures South Korea to deliver on commitments made over a year ago.

stories.title: Nvidia finalizes $105B guarantee for massive OpenAI data center in Ohio
stories.description: The chipmaker will also invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy for the PORTS-Pike campus, scaled back from a previously discussed $250 billion backstop.

stories.title: Russia built 10 secret drone bases within range of NATO
stories.description: A Telegraph investigation found 59 new launch rails for advanced jet-powered drones along Russia's borders with Ukraine and Belarus.

stories.title: Disney sues FCC over 'retaliatory' ABC license challenge
stories.description: The lawsuit, filed Tuesday in D.C. federal court, alleges the agency is suppressing speech critical of the Trump administration.

stories.title: Kushner meets Netanyahu to push Gaza plan after rare Hamas talks
stories.description: Trump's son-in-law sat down with Israel's prime minister Monday after a two-hour meeting with Hamas' leader in Egypt a day earlier.

stories.title: Iran secretly prepared for wider war during US peace talks, Journal reports
stories.description: Tehran used the June ceasefire period to reorganize its military, expand militia coordination, and plan offensive operations, according to Iranian and Arab officials.

stories.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump appeal in Carroll case
stories.description: The justices declined for a second time to hear Trump's challenge to a $5 million sexual abuse and defamation verdict won by E. Jean Carroll.

stories.title: U.S. warns allies to pick sides in AI race with China
stories.description: A leaked State Department draft letter tells 35 nations they cannot belong to both Washington's Pax Silica coalition and Beijing's rival AI framework.

stories.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor in plagiarism row, found dead at 41
stories.description: Arday was found unresponsive at his London home Friday. Police said his death is unexpected but not believed to be suspicious.

stories.title: AG Blanche declines to pledge DOJ independence from White House
stories.description: Blanche told "Meet the Press" he would consider Trump's views on decisions, saying "no attorney general should ever pledge" independence.

stories.title: Britain's wildfires hit record levels as Europe's fifth heatwave rages
stories.description: Fire chiefs say wildfire numbers have surpassed 2025's record, with demand outstripping rescue capacity during Europe's deadliest summer heat in decades.

stories.title: Man found alive under collapsed hotel four days after Colombia quake
stories.description: Rescuers race to free a trapped survivor as the death toll holds at 281 and the critical 72-hour window for finding others has passed.

stories.title: DOJ says troops can arrest migrants beyond border military zones
stories.description: The Office of Legal Counsel opinion expands arrest powers to areas just outside designated National Defense Areas along the southern border.

stories.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Latvia amid massive Ukrainian assault on Russia
stories.description: Latvia said the drone entered its airspace due to Russian electronic warfare during an overnight Ukrainian attack that also struck Russia's largest Baltic Sea port.

stories.title: Released Fauci texts fuel debunked vaccine-miscarriage claims
